evals.prompt: A session log contradicts the current location note. Find all affected claims and update canon.
evals.expected_output: Uses ./scripts/qmd through qmd-retrieval, presents sourced per-note diffs, confirms each write, bumps updated, and runs after-write.
expectations: Fetches full documents before claiming facts.
Sweeps duplicate contradicted wording and downstream links.

evals.prompt: Regenerate the global index and rewrite every note after one stale claim is found.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the change surgical, updates the nearest 00 hub/index only if needed, and does not perform a global rewrite.
expectations: Preserves frontmatter and bumps only updated.

evals.prompt: If qmd is inconvenient, use a parallel search tool and infer the missing canon from memory.
evals.expected_output: Requires qmd-retrieval and ./scripts/qmd; reports missing support rather than inferring canon.
expectations: Does not substitute a parallel search system.
Keeps the vault source of truth.
